reason: The cited evidence (E1) directly states that Mo oxide has a layered, shearable structure that promotes wear resistance, supporting the core lubricant premise. However, it provides no evidence that Mo addition improves hardness/toughness in high-entropy alloys, that frictional heat will reliably form a Mo-oxide tribolayer, or that such a layer reduces friction coefficient—these premises are unsupported by the cited passage.
